# Scratch Pad

A small transient Tkinter text editor window.

## Overview

The source opens a wrapped text widget and focuses it. It contains no persistence code.

## Usage

From `examples/desktop-app/`, run:

```bash
python3 app.py
```

Type in the window. Closing it discards its contents; copy anything needed before closing.

## Requirements and limitations

Use Python 3 with working Tkinter and a graphical session. Only source and syntax were inspected; the GUI was not launched.
